title: Public laundries and central washing facilities.
officialText: In public coin-operated laundries and in the central washing facilities of multiple-family dwellings, the rooms containing automatic clothes washers shall be provided with floor drains located to readily drain the entire floor area. Such drains shall have a minimum 3 inch (76 mm) diameter drain outlet and be provided with lint strainers.
